text: 1. Scanned copy of valid passport’s information page;2. Notarized copy of highest academic degree certificate or graduation diploma and transcripts (Graduating students should provide pre-graduation certificate issued by the authorities of the school, and provide the copy of graduation diploma when registration);3. The transcript of the university and language certificate (HSK);4. Two recommendation letters: The referee should be professor or associate professor;5. Study plan in China. Above 1000 words for master candidates, above 1500 words for PhD candidates. The content should include (but not limited to) study and work experience, academic research achievement, planned research proposal, and career plan after graduation, etc in Chinese or in English;6. List and abstracts of published papers or other materials demonstrating research abilities;7. ID photo (2-inch blue background photo without hats);8. English or Chinese self-introduction video (3-5 minutes, no more than 50M);9. Scanned copy of Foreigner’s Physical Examination Form;10. If the applicant is working, please Notarized Carrier Certificate made by the institution where you are working. Other documents may certify your professional and personal background should be helpful;11. Financial Guarantee Letter and scanned copies of its supporting documents completed in Chinese or English.
